scope: Static source and exact evidence custody; constructed tests only. No historical model calls, fits, simulation or native likelihood evaluation.
source_checks: Separate new package and index schema; all predecessor execution and scientific source hashes remain exact.
First transition invokes original accepted_index under the actual old source identity; accepted case/trace/attempt/review/resume bytes are archived and pinned.
Amendment rejects missing or altered resume evidence, altered original reviews prefix, and admission expiry extending the frozen shared run.
Each new attempt has the next exact case and frozen external wall cap; original startup/finalization allowance does not enlarge that cap.
One unchanged scientific delegate executes per attempt; pilot fits are copied, never repeated. Bounds, starts, tolerances, quadrature and gates remain unchanged.
Every failed or partial attempt blocks automatic progression; killed or unpersisted attempts require external conductor accounting.
Final receipt/index serialization is deadline-tested and late results are rewritten failed.
Any complete all80 result still requires original scientific checks and independent400-outcome aggregation.
resolved_findings: Mandatory exact original training_resume evidence and first-case provenance added.
Original review prefix now checked in every migrated index.
Admission expiry now bounded by immutable shared-run expiry.
limitations: No actual budgeted batch has executed under this source; controller/workflow command, mandatory source pins, runtime/native copying and external supervision require separate review.
This is a finite fixed opportunity, not a forecast that all75 remaining cases will complete; the rejected original projection remains failed.
RSS is sampled rather than a hard memory reservation; process lifetime bounds rely on the separately audited external supervisor.
A failed or killed process whose receipts cannot be persisted must remain charged in external accounting and cannot receive automatic continuation.
